headline: $15 gets you Psychonauts 2, the latest Like a Dragon game, and more
summary: Humble Choice offers a strong lineup for $14.99 this month. Games include Like A Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii and Psychonauts 2. Subscribers also get Price of Persia: The Lost Crown and other PC titles.

headline: Apple’s new Find My-compatible remote will also work with your old Apple TV
summary: Apple's new Siri Remote with Find My costs $59 standalone. It's compatible with all Apple TV models, not just the new 4K. The remote features a built-in speaker for easier locating.

headline: Halo’s co-creator wrote a novel about AI taking over the world
summary: Jason Jones, Halo co-creator, penned a novel about AI. The manuscript, written in 2019, explores AI world domination. He sought feedback from former Bungie colleague Margaret Stohl.

headline: Epic’s new games launcher is ‘vibe coded’
summary: Epic Games is launching a refreshed, faster PC game launcher. The new launcher now supports Linux and is available in preview. Epic describes the development process as "vibe coded," hinting at AI assistance.

headline: 'The Library Loads 30x Faster’ – The New, Much Speedier Epic Games Launcher Has Arrived
summary: The rebuilt Epic Games Launcher is now available in preview. It promises significantly faster load times, up to 30x for the library. Epic claims it's even speedier than the old version and Steam.

headline: Borderlands 4 Plummets to $20 at Amazon, Hitting New Low Price
summary: Borderlands 4 is now just $19.91 on Amazon. This marks a new all-time low price for the game. The deal applies to both PS5 and Xbox Series X versions, a 60% discount.

headline: 29 New Changes in the Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake — Redesigned Puzzles, Updated Miniboss Fights, and Deeper Dialogue
summary: The Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake introduces 29 new changes. Altered puzzles and redesigned miniboss fights enhance gameplay. New shortcuts and deeper dialogue make navigation more intuitive.

headline: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Is Surprisingly More Different Than You Think | IGN Preview
summary: The Ocarina of Time remake offers significant departures from the original. Redesigned challenges, updated controls, and enhanced art redefine the experience. It aims for depth, presenting the classic story as a legend retold with new texture.

headline: Russell Brand was a 'sexual predator', says prosecution as rape trial begins
summary: Russell Brand's rape trial has commenced. The prosecution labeled the actor and comedian a 'sexual predator'. Brand has pleaded not guilty to multiple counts of rape and sexual assault.

headline: Starlink restrictions in Ukraine war linked to political situation, Zelensky aide says
summary: Starlink restrictions in Ukraine are tied to the political situation. Elon Musk's system is crucial for Ukraine's air defense. Starlink enables effective guidance of drones against Russian targets.

headline: Burnham careful before Zelensky meeting but promises Ukraine won't leave 'empty handed'
summary: UK Prime Minister Burnham is set to meet Volodymyr Zelensky. The meeting follows a challenging week for the Ukrainian president. Burnham promises Ukraine will receive tangible support from the UK.

headline: Family pays tribute to 'warm and engaging' man killed in tiger attack
summary: A man named William Chapman was tragically killed in a tiger attack. The incident occurred after he entered the tiger's pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park. His family remembers him as a "warm and engaging" individual.
